SECTION B: Very Short Answer Type Questions (2 Marks Each)

Q22. “The issue of sustainability is important for development.” Justify the statement.

Answer / Solution:
“The issue of sustainability is important for development.” Justify the statement. 
Sustainability ensures that development meets present needs without 
compromising the needs of future generations. 
It prevents environmental degradation and exhaustion of resources, ensuring 
continuous progress.
